projects.title: Satellite Watch
projects.hook: Thousands of satellites. Which one is over you?
projects.description: Every kind of satellite live on a world map: space stations, Starlink, OneWeb, weather, GPS and the other navigation systems, Iridium, amateur radio, Hubble and Earth-watchers, the brightest ones, and last month's launches. Tap one for its story and ground track, and see when it next flies over you.

projects.hook: One desk. Every AI at the table.
